note: Helsinki / UNSA campaign-visible fields under the canonical universal skill system defined by issue #159. This file narrows fields for play; it does not replace RULEBOOK.md §4.1 or data/rules/skills.json.

boundaries.Know: Answers from learned domain knowledge; Law is Know (Law).
boundaries.Research: Finds, verifies, and synthesizes external information; OSINT lives here.
boundaries.Investigation: Reconstructs a specific case from evidence.
boundaries.Intelligence Analysis: Turns multiple sources into assessed judgments under uncertainty.
boundaries.Perceive: Immediate physical and augmented sensory noticing.
boundaries.Kinesics: Inference from behavior, body language, tells, and social cues.
boundaries.Psi: Issue #159 replaces the generic Psi placeholder with ESP, Telepathy, Psychokinesis, Precognition, Noöspace, and Psychic Defence.
boundaries.Hardware (Psychotronics): Engineering of psychotronic/noetic hardware; psychic operation uses the relevant PSY skill.

campaign_extension_rule: Add fields only when a character concept, scenario, location, profession, or equipment creates a genuine play need; related fields may substitute at -1 per issue #159.
